Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate representing the State.

The instant bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 61 of 2022, under Sections 376, 506, 354-D IPC, Police Station-Poonch, District-Jhansi, during the pendency of trial.

As per the prosecution case in brief, victim who is wife of younger brother of the applicant has lodged an FIR on 03.04.2022 against Ram Gopal (present applicant) with the allegation inter-alia that on 21.03.2022 when she was sleeping in her room, applicant entered into her room at about 11:00-12:00 o'clock in the night and took her to his room where he, on the pointing of knife,
disrobed her and committed rape on her and also made her obscene video.

FIR further alleges that the applicant also threatened her that in case she tells anyone about this incident, he will make her Ram Gopal vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84394107/
1 video viral.

sentences.text: It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is brother-in-law (Jeth) of the victim and he has been falsely implicated in this case on account of family dispute with the husband of the victim.

Referring to the statements under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. of the victim, it is pointed out that the victim in her statements has also stated inter-alia that four daughters and one son of the applicant, who were aged about 18 years, 12 years, 8 years, 6 years and 15 years, were also sleeping with her.

At that time, applicant entered into her room and took her to another room where he committed rape on her and also made her video whereas during the course of the investigation,
the investigating officer did not record the statement of children of the applicant and also did not collect any video as alleged in the FIR as well as in the statements of the victim.
After culmination of investigation, charge-sheet has also not been submitted for the offence under Section Information Technology Act, 2008.
Lastly it is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has no criminal history to his credit and is languishing in jail since 04.04.2022.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant but could not dispute the factum of the case as argued on behalf of the applicant.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find that FIR has been lodged after delay of 14 days.
The statement of children of the applicant, who were also sleeping with the victim, were not recorded by the investigating officer whereas they are material witnesses of this case.
The victim has also refused for her internal or external medical examination.
In this case, no video has been recovered.

Since the applicant is brother-in-law of the victim,
therefore, under the facts of the case, possibility of his false implication cannot be ruled out.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused and submissions of the learned counsel for the parties
, I am of the view that the applicant has made out a fit case for bail.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant-Ram Gopal, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) That the applicant shall cooperate in the expeditious disposal of the trial and shall regularly attend the court unless inevitable.
(ii) That the applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) That after his release, the applicant shall not involve in any criminal activity.
